title: Network Engineer
description:
Job Description I&O Platform Infrastructure Network Engineer Supervising Associate | Enterprise Technology   The opportunity In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a proven Network Engineer to support and evolve EY's global data center and enterprise network infrastructure. The role will provide engineering, operational support, automation and lifecycle management across EY's campus, data center and wide-area network environments. The successful candidate will work with cutting-edge networking technologies with a specific focus on routing and switching, data center fabric, network security, SD-WAN, load balancing and network automation.   Your key responsibilities The I&O Platform Infrastructure Network Engineer provides technical support and engineering of complex nature for the firm's global enterprise network platforms. This professional applies knowledge of multi-vendor routing and switching, data center networking, network security, WAN technologies and automation tooling to support enterprise-scale connectivity and availability. The role requires in-depth knowledge of the firm's network architecture to implement platform enhancements, lifecycle management activities, patching programs, security initiatives and operational improvements. The engineer will assist in maintaining highly available, high-performance network environments across global data center and office locations while ensuring compliance, resiliency and operational excellence.   Skills and attributes for success Strong experience designing and administering enterprise data center and campus network environments. Deep knowledge of routing protocols including BGP, OSPF, EIGRP and IS-IS. Strong Layer 2 switching experience including VLANs, STP, RSTP, MSTP and VPC/MLAG. Experience with Cisco, Arista or Juniper data center switching platforms (exclusionary). Experience maintaining mission-critical production network environments in a global data center setting (exclusionary). Experience supporting SD-WAN platforms (Cisco Viptela, VMware VeloCloud or equivalent). Strong knowledge of network security technologies including: Firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco ASA/FTD, Fortinet or equivalent) Network Access Control (NAC) IDS/IPS VPN — IPsec and SSL/TLS Microsegmentation Experience with data center fabric technologies including: VXLAN EVPN Spine-leaf architecture ACI or equivalent SDN platforms Experience with load balancing platforms (F5 BIG-IP, Citrix ADC or equivalent). Knowledge of DNS, DHCP and IPAM (DDI) management. Experience with network automation and Infrastructure-as-Code tooling including: Ansible Python / Netmiko / NAPALM Terraform Experience with network monitoring and observability platforms (SolarWinds, PRTG, ThousandEyes or equivalent). Ability to create technical documentation, network diagrams and operational runbooks. Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks. Ability to work effectively with clients, management and global engineering teams.   To qualify for the role, you must have experience with Enterprise routing and switching administration — 5–7 years. BGP, OSPF and other dynamic routing protocol configuration and troubleshooting — 5–7 years. Data center switching platforms (Cisco Nexus, Arista EOS, Juniper QFX or equivalent) — 5–7 years. Layer 2 technologies including VLANs, VPC, MLAG, STP and trunking — 5–7 years. Enterprise firewall administration (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD, Fortinet or equivalent) — 5–7 years. SD-WAN deployment and operational management — 3–5 years. VXLAN/EVPN data center fabric design and administration. Spine-leaf architecture deployment and operations. F5 BIG-IP LTM/GTM load balancer administration. IPsec and SSL VPN configuration and troubleshooting. DDI management (DNS, DHCP, IPAM). Network automation scripting using Python, Ansible or equivalent. Network change management, patching and firmware lifecycle management. Network monitoring, alerting and capacity management. Packet capture and traffic analysis (Wireshark, tcpdump or equivalent). Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity planning for network platforms. Security hardening and vulnerability remediation of network infrastructure. Cloud networking fundamentals — Azure Virtual Network, AWS VPC or equivalent. Hybrid connectivity including ExpressRoute, Direct Connect or equivalent (preferred).   Ideally, you'll also have Cisco CCNP (Enterprise, Data Center or Security) certification (desired). Arista ACE certification (desired). Palo Alto PCNSE certification (desired). Juniper JNCIP certification (better to have). F5 201 / 301 certification (better to have). ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary). Cisco CCIE (Enterprise Infrastructure or Data Center) — better to have. Experience with network telemetry and streaming (gNMI, gRPC, OpenConfig). Experience with Cisco ACI or VMware NSX SDN platforms. Familiarity with zero-trust network access (ZTNA) frameworks and implementation.   What we look for An experienced and technically strong network engineer to help build, maintain and modernize EY's global enterprise network infrastructure. We are looking for an individual with deep multi-vendor networking expertise, a passion for automation and security, and the ability to support highly available, high-performance network platforms while driving continuous operational improvement across EY's data center and wide-area network estate.

Key Skills: Routing and Switching,patch deployment,Arista,Vulnerability Management,Scripting,Networking,Security,Routing

title: Network Engineer  BNG and Broadband Access
description:
Job Summary We are hiring a Network Engineer with strong experience in BNG (Broadband Network Gateway) platforms and broadband access technologies to manage, troubleshoot, and optimize service provider broadband networks. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Juniper MX960/MX304 and Huawei BNG platforms, along with GPON/FTTH access network troubleshooting. Key Responsibilities Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot BNG platforms (Juniper MX960/MX304, Huawei) for subscriber management. Manage subscriber authentication, authorization, and accounting (AAA) via RADIUS/PPPoE/DHCP. Troubleshoot broadband service issues across OLT, ONT/ONU, and GPON access infrastructure. Perform end-to-end fault isolation from BNG to OLT to CPE for broadband/FTTH customer complaints. Handle provisioning, activation, and configuration of broadband/FTTH subscriber services. Monitor OLT/GPON network health, optical power levels, and PON port utilization. Coordinate with field engineering teams for fiber faults, splicing, and last-mile issues. Support VoIP/IPTV service delivery troubleshooting over GPON/FTTH where applicable. Perform capacity planning and utilization analysis for BNG and OLT platforms. Execute planned maintenance, firmware/software upgrades on BNG and OLT equipment. Maintain network documentation, IP addressing plans, and subscriber provisioning records. Ensure SLA compliance for broadband service availability and fault resolution. Must-Have Skills & Keywords Hands-on experience with BNG (Broadband Network Gateway) configuration and troubleshooting. Strong knowledge of subscriber management protocols PPPoE, DHCP, RADIUS, AAA. Practical experience with GPON/FTTH access network architecture and troubleshooting. Understanding of OLT/ONU/ONT provisioning and optical power/link budget troubleshooting. Strong IP routing and switching fundamentals for service provider networks. Experience in a Service Provider / Telecom / ISP environment. Good understanding of QoS and bandwidth management for broadband services. Strong problem-solving skills and customer-impact-driven troubleshooting approach. Technologies / Protocols (MPLS & Core Networking) BNG (Broadband Network Gateway) – Subscriber Management, Service Profiles PPPoE, DHCP, RADIUS/AAA, IPoE GPON (Gigabit Passive Optical Network) architecture FTTH (Fiber to the Home) – OLT, ONT/ONU provisioning and troubleshooting Optical parameters – Rx/Tx power levels, PON budget, fiber loss troubleshooting IP Routing – BGP, OSPF, Static Routing basics VLAN, QinQ (802.1ad) for subscriber service separation QoS – Bandwidth profiling, traffic shaping for broadband services MPLS basics for backhaul connectivity (added advantage) IPv4/IPv6 addressing and subscriber IP management OEM / Vendor Platform Experience Juniper – MX960, MX304 (BNG/Edge Routing Platforms), JUNOS Huawei – BNG Platforms (NE Series), OLT (MA5600T/MA5800 series), VRP OS Nokia (Alcatel-Lucent) – 7750 SR BNG – Preferred Cisco – ASR Series (BNG/Edge) – Preferred GPON OLT/ONT equipment – Huawei / ZTE / Nokia (any of these) Certifications (Required / Preferred) CCNA (Routing & Switching) – Required CCNP (Service Provider / R&S) – Preferred JNCIA / JNCIS (Juniper Service Provider) – Preferred HCIA / HCIP (Huawei Datacom / Access) – Preferred Service Provider Certification – Nokia NRS I / equivalent – Preferred Good to Have Experience with IPTV/VoIP service troubleshooting over broadband. Exposure to fiber network planning and last-mile fault management tools. Knowledge of network automation/scripting for provisioning tasks.

title: Noc Network Engineer L2
description:
Job Summary We are seeking a skilled L2 Network Engineer to join our 24x7 NOC team. The role involves monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining IP/MPLS routing and switching infrastructure, handling incident escalations from L1, and ensuring optimal network performance across a multi-vendor service provider environment. Key Responsibilities Monitor network performance and availability through NMS/EMS dashboards and alarms. Handle L2-level troubleshooting for routing, switching, and MPLS-related incidents escalated from L1. Perform fault isolation and resolution for network outages within defined SLA timelines. Configure and maintain routers/switches as per approved MOPs and change requests. Log, track, and update incident tickets in the ITSM/ticketing tool (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy). Coordinate with field/onsite teams for hardware replacement and physical link issues. Escalate unresolved critical issues to L3/vendor support with proper documentation. Support scheduled maintenance activities, patching, and software upgrades. Maintain accurate shift handover reports and network status logs. Assist in capacity monitoring and utilization reporting of network links. Must-Have Skills & Keywords Solid understanding of IP Routing and Switching fundamentals (L2/L3). Working knowledge of MPLS concepts and service provider network operations. Hands-on experience troubleshooting BGP, OSPF, and static routing. Good understanding of VLAN, Spanning Tree (STP/RSTP), and Link Aggregation (LACP). Familiarity with NMS/EMS monitoring tools and alarm management. Basic ITIL process knowledge Incident and Change Management. Ability to work in rotational 24x7 shifts (including night shifts). Good communication and documentation skills. Technologies / Protocols (MPLS & Core Networking) MPLS Fundamentals – LDP, Label Switched Paths (LSP) MPLS VPN – L3VPN, L2VPN basics BGP, OSPF – Configuration and basic troubleshooting VLAN, Trunking, STP/RSTP, LACP, Etherchannel QoS basics – CoS/DSCP marking and prioritization HSRP / VRRP – First Hop Redundancy Protocols IP Addressing, Subnetting, and NAT Network Access Control Lists (ACLs) OEM / Vendor Platform Experience Cisco – ISR/ASR/Catalyst Series, IOS/IOS-XE Juniper – MX/EX Series, JUNOS basics Nokia (Alcatel-Lucent) – 7750/7450 SR OS basics Huawei – NE/CX Routers, S Series Switches, VRP OS Arista – 7000 Series Switches, EOS basics Certifications (Required / Preferred) CCNA (Routing & Switching) – Required CCNP (Routing & Switching / SP) – Preferred JNCIA (Juniper) – Preferred HCIA (Huawei) – Preferred Nokia NRS I – Preferred Good to Have Exposure to Arista EOS-based data center switching. Basic scripting knowledge (Python) for automation tasks. Prior experience in a Telecom/ISP NOC environment.

title: Senior L2 Network Engineer  NOC
description:
Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Senior L2 Network Engineer to join our NOC team, responsible for advanced troubleshooting, configuration, and maintenance of large-scale IP/MPLS backbone and service provider networks. The candidate will act as the escalation point for L1 engineers, lead incident/problem management, and drive network stability, performance, and change management across multi-vendor environments. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary L2/L3 escalation point for complex network incidents raised by the NOC L1 team. Perform end-to-end troubleshooting of IP/MPLS core, aggregation, and access network issues. Configure, monitor, and maintain routers, switches, and MPLS PE/P/CE devices across the network. Own Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major/critical incidents and prepare detailed RCA reports. Plan and execute network changes, upgrades, and maintenance activities (MOPs) with minimal service impact. Monitor network health using NMS/EMS tools; proactively identify and resolve performance degradation. Coordinate with vendors (Cisco/Juniper/Nokia/Huawei/Arista TAC) for hardware/software escalations. Maintain network documentation, topology diagrams, SOPs, and configuration backups. Mentor and guide L1/L2 engineers; conduct knowledge transfer and training sessions. Ensure adherence to SLA, KPI, and uptime targets defined by the organization/customer. Participate in capacity planning, network design reviews, and new site/service rollouts. Handle shift-based NOC operations including rotational/on-call support as required. Must-Have Skills & Keywords Strong hands-on expertise in IP Routing and Switching (Layer 2 & Layer 3). Deep working knowledge of MPLS architecture and service provider backbone networks. Advanced troubleshooting skills for BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, EIGRP, and static routing. Strong understanding of VLAN, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP, Link Aggregation, and Etherchannel. Experience with network monitoring tools (NMS/EMS SolarWinds, Nagios, Zabbix, vendor-specific EMS). Incident, Problem, and Change Management (ITIL process exposure). Strong analytical and packet-level troubleshooting ability (Wireshark, packet capture analysis). Excellent communication skills for customer/vendor escalation handling. Technologies / Protocols (MPLS & Core Networking) MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) – Label Distribution, LDP, RSVP-TE MPLS L3VPN / L2VPN (VPLS, VPWS, EVPN) BGP (iBGP/eBGP), MP-BGP, Route Reflectors, BGP Communities & Policies OSPF, IS-IS, EIGRP – IGP design and troubleshooting Traffic Engineering (RSVP-TE, Fast Reroute / FRR) QoS – Classification, Marking, Policing, Shaping, CoS/DSCP VRF / VPN Routing & Forwarding, Segment Routing (SR-MPLS) – added advantage Layer 2/3 Switching – VLAN, Trunking, STP/RSTP/MSTP, LACP Network Redundancy Protocols – HSRP, VRRP, GLBP Network Security Basics – ACLs, uRPF, control-plane policing IP Addressing, Subnetting, VLSM, and NAT OEM / Vendor Platform Experience Cisco – ASR/NCS/ISR/Catalyst platforms, IOS/IOS-XR/IOS-XE Juniper – MX Series, PTX, EX Series, JUNOS Nokia (Alcatel-Lucent) – 7750 SR, 7450 ESS, SR OS Huawei – NE/CX Series Routers, S Series Switches, VRP OS Arista – 7000 Series Switches, EOS Certifications (Required / Preferred) CCNP (Routing & Switching / Service Provider) – Required CCIE (R&S / SP) – Preferred / Added Advantage JNCIA / JNCIS / JNCIP (Juniper) – Preferred Nokia NRS I / NRS II (Service Routing Certification) – Preferred HCIA / HCIP (Huawei Routing & Switching) – Preferred Arista ACE (Arista Certified Engineer) – Preferred ITIL Foundation Certification – Preferred Good to Have Exposure to Segment Routing (SR-MPLS/SRv6). Experience with automation/scripting (Python, Ansible) for network operations. Exposure to SDN/SD-WAN and network orchestration tools. Experience in a 24x7 Tier-1/Tier-2 Service Provider or ISP NOC environment.
